status: Implemented; recorded focused/client evidence retained and final full/native regressions passed. See the stated verification scope.
thermalMeasurement: Original ThermalSensorProcess measures relative thermal delta plus the sensor own local ambient. Adjacent blocks can use different biome profiles; stored normal-world evidence records different ambient values. The settling fixture now compares the actual coupled thermal deltas with the same 0.6 K tolerance, while retaining independent loaded current, finite thermal response, real signal voltage and invalid-hardware checks. Runtime thermal equations were not changed.
projectedLight: The five-tick lease still expires independently of normal block/entity ticking. The fixture now asserts zero-emission block removal by ten ticks, unchanged forced-chunk set and a genuinely loaded non-ticking chunk. It then waits for actual threaded light propagation to reach zero with a bounded 120-tick deadline, matching the activation readiness bound. It does not infer brightness from a block emission property. Runtime lighting code was not changed.
